findings.claim: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance via NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver f. Logs written through FromContext(ctx), such as those from LoggerMiddleware, go to a throwaway logger, so tests asserting on the original TestLogger see no calls.

verifier.reason: In pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:46-48, TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger() (a fresh &TestLogger{} from pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:14-16) instead of the receiver f. Consequently, calls such as m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...) in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58 record logs on a discarded instance and leave the original TestLogger's fields unmodified.

findings.claim: ContextualLoggerMiddleware's QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext with no nil check on req, so a nil request panics. Other middlewares, including LoggerMiddleware, guard against nil requests.

verifier.reason: ContextualLoggerMiddleware dereferences req.PluginContext without nil checks in QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go:39-57), whereas LoggerMiddleware and other middlewares guard against nil req (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:63,77,90,104). Impact is limited because client.Decorator rejects nil requests before running middlewares (pkg/plugins/manager/client/decorator.go:25-60), so this only panics if ContextualLoggerMiddleware is invoked directly outside Decorator.
